create_tokenizer: create a Tokenizer instance with a vocab path to prepare CLIP text tokenization
tokenize_single_text: tokenize a single string into a padded tensor with start and end tokens
tokenize_batch_texts: tokenize a list of strings into a batch tensor with fixed context length
tokenize_with_custom_context_length: tokenize text with a custom context length instead of the default 77 tokens
review_tokenizer_truncation: review the Tokenizer class and how it truncates long token sequences to context length
